## Docs checklist
- [ ] `docs/changelog.md` entry and `package.json` version (feature releases)
- [ ] `docs/schema-changelog.md` entry and `docs/airtable-schema.md` (any Airtable change), with how to apply it to an existing base
- [ ] `docs/user-guide.md` updated for new or changed behavior
- [ ] `docs/why-it-works-this-way.md` explains any new design choice and the alternative rejected
- [ ] `docs/customizing.md` and `public/config.js` for new settings
- [ ] `docs/troubleshooting.md` for new failure modes
- [ ] Tried it with `npm run demo`
- [ ] No tokens, real client names or real base IDs
